titleEnglish: Tumhein Dillagi Bhool Jaani Paregi — Purnam Allahabadi

verses.ar:
Tumhein dillagi bhool jaani parhe gi
Mohabbat ki raahon mein aa kar to dekho
verses.en:
You will have to forget this game of the heart
Come walk the paths of true love and see

verses.ar:
Tarapne pe mere na phir tum haso ge
Kabhi dil kisi se laga kar to dekho
verses.en:
You will not laugh at my anguish again
Try giving your heart to someone and see

verses.ar:
Honton ke paas aaye hasi, kya majaal hai
Dil ka muamla hai koi dillagi nahi
verses.en:
Laughter dare not come near the lips
This is a matter of the heart — it is no game

verses.ar:
Zakhm pe zakhm kha ke jee
Apne lahu ke ghoont pee
Aah na kar labon ko see
Ishq hai dillagi nahi
verses.en:
Live by taking wound upon wound
Swallow the draughts of your own blood
Do not sigh — stitch your lips shut
This is love — it is no game

verses.ar:
Dil laga kar pata chale ga tumhein
Aashiqi dillagi nahi hoti
verses.en:
Once you have given your heart you will understand
True devotion is no game

verses.ar:
Kuch khel nahi hai ishq ki laag
Paani na samajh yeh aag hai aag
verses.en:
The grip of love is no child's play
Do not mistake it for water — this is fire, real fire

verses.ar:
Khoon rulaye gi yeh lagi dil ki
Khel samjho na dillagi dil ki
verses.en:
This attachment of the heart will make you weep blood
Do not treat the heart's affair as a game

verses.ar:
Yeh ishq nahi aasaan
Bas itna samajh lijiye
Ek aag ka darya hai
Aur doob ke jaana hai
verses.en:
This love is not easy
Understand just this much
It is a river of fire
And one must drown in it

verses.ar:
Wafaon ki ham se tawwaqo nahi hai
Magar eik baar aazmaa kar to dekho
Zamane ko apna bana kar to dekha
Hame bhi tum apna bana kar to dekho
verses.en:
You expect no faithfulness from me
But try putting me to the test just once and see
You have tried to make the world your own
Now try making me yours and see

verses.ar:
Khuda ke liye chhor do ab yeh parda
Rukh se niqaab utha ke barhi dair ho gayi
Mahool ko talawat-e-quran kiye hue
verses.en:
For God's sake lift this veil now
Long has it been since the veil was raised from your face
The atmosphere has long been reciting Quran

verses.ar:
Ham na samjhein teri nazron ka taqaza kya hai
Kabhi parda, kabhi jalwa, yeh tamasha kya hai
verses.en:
We cannot fathom what your glances demand
Sometimes a veil, sometimes a radiance — what is this show?

verses.ar:
Jaan-e-jaan, ham se yeh uljhan nahi dekhi jaati
Ke hain aaj hum tum nahi ghair koi
Shab-e-vasl bhi hai hijaab iss qadr kyun
Zara rukh se aanchal utha kar to dekho
verses.en:
O beloved, I cannot bear this confusion any longer
Today it is only you and I — no stranger is here
Why even on the night of union is there this much veil?
Just lift the hem from your face a little and see

verses.ar:
Jafa'ein bahot ki bahot zulm dhaaye
Kabhi ek nigah-e-karam iss taraf bhi
Hamesha hue dekh kar mujh ko barham
Kisi din zara muskura kar to dekho
verses.en:
You have inflicted much cruelty, much oppression
Cast at least one merciful glance this way too
You have always been vexed at the sight of me
One day try smiling a little and see

verses.ar:
Jo ulfat mein har ek sitam hai gawara
Yeh sab kuch hai paas-e-wafa tum se warna
Sataate ho din raat jis tarah mujh ko
Kisi ghair ko yoon sataa kar to dekho
verses.en:
That every torment in love is acceptable —
All of this is only out of faithfulness to you
The way you torment me day and night
Try tormenting a stranger like this and see

verses.ar:
Agar'che kisi baat par woh khafa hain
To acha yehi hai tum apni see kar lo
Woh maane na-maane yeh marzi hai unki
Magar unko 'Purnam' mana kar to dekho
verses.en:
Even if they are displeased about something
The best thing is to make your own peace
Whether they relent or not is their will
But try winning them over, O Purnam, and see
